title: Overnight curfews announced in parts of Paris and Nice after riots across France - BBC
description: The order in the French capital comes into force at 23:00 local time (22:00 BST). In Nice, restrictions specifically for young people will begin at 21:00.

title: Davante Adams (hamstring) expected to miss 6-10 weeks as injuries pile up for Rams - NFL.com
description: Wide receiver Davante Adams suffered a hamstring injury in L.A.'s 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday and is expected to miss six to 10 weeks, HC Sean McVay told reporters.

title: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq Rebounds at Open After Friday's Tech Selloff — Live Updates - WSJ
description: Live updates on stocks, bonds and markets, including the Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite, and oil prices.
